text: Ben maɓɓe maakani ɓe: hara mi hooloray on e fii makko, si wanaa no mi hoolornoo non e neene-gooto makko on Yuusufa oya tuma? Mi hoolino on e fii on ɗon, foduɗon lam reenugol mo, on hunnaali ahdi. Hoolaare alanaa on ka an wonnde on reenay mo, ko Alla mi hoolori; ko Kanko woni moƴƴo reenoowo on mo O yiɗi reenude, ɓurɗo moƴƴude yurmeteeɓe ɓen, wonannde mo O yiɗi yurmeede.
